name: How does AKN Design Group prioritize different aspects of a project schedule, such as demolition versus finish work?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group prioritize different aspects of a project schedule, such as demolition versus finish work?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group prioritizes different aspects of a project schedule by establishing a logical sequence of work, moving from preparatory stages to detailed finishes. Demolition and structural work are typically prioritized early to define the new space, followed by rough-ins for essential systems like plumbing and electrical. Finish work, including custom cabinetry, flooring, and paint, is then carefully scheduled to ensure optimal quality and protection of newly installed elements. This methodical approach, part of our managed process, ensures craftsmanship and efficiency, culminating in a beautiful, lasting impression.
acceptedAnswer.description: We prioritize project schedule aspects by following a logical sequence: preparatory work first, then rough-ins, and finally detailed finishes to ensure quality and efficiency.
